definition.dose: the same state is stepped twice on sentence 1, with fast x0 and fast x1000

definition.localise: a ratio below 0.1 marks that stage as the damping site
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy readings on the main subject stay equal before and after

criteria.write: the written fast has abs sum > 0
criteria.ratios: both ratios are reported with the raw deltas
criteria.decision: the damping site follows the frozen 0.1 rule and is reported with its exit name
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal and the main parameter digest does not move
